description:
Find the Kromatic method, example or template that fits the user's situation, such as checking demand for a feature before building it, testing whether people will pay a given price, getting first paying commitments before launch, or deciding whether to keep funding a project.

Method names rank far better than everyday wording, so include them: "fake door test", "pre-sales test", "sales pitch test", "concierge test", "pivot or persevere". If you are unsure which method fits, search {"query": "Index of Questions", "source_keys": ["real_startup_book"]}. Returns up to 20 ranked excerpts (limit, default 5), each with document_title, canonical_url, resource_type and document_external_key. These are excerpts, not whole pages. No sign-in needed.

Next: call read_resource with the best result's document_external_key.

query.description: What to find. Include method names where you can (see the tool description).
query.title: Query

resource_types.description: Optional. Only these types. Book Section = a method page of The Real Startup Book. Download = a template or worksheet; Download File = one file inside it. Tool = the full guide text for one of Kromatic's interactive web apps (e.g. Experiment Calculator, Startup Poker); Tools / Games = the website's link entry for the same apps, with less text. Prefer Tool when you want content.
resource_types.title: Resource Types

source_keys.description: Optional. Only these sources: real_startup_book (method pages), blog_content (Kromatic blog), learning_library (courses, lessons, templates, MCP Server and Skill entries), tools_and_games.
source_keys.title: Source Keys
